name: error-unsupported-encoding
description: A coding with no decoder is an error, not a pass-through.
grounding: Passing the bytes through hands a reducer compressed input and reports the failure as a parse error well away from the actual cause — which is exactly how PCC-1126 stayed invisible. The bytes are stored either way, so erroring here loses nothing and names the real problem.
notes: deflate is unsupported deliberately: no capture path emits it, and a decoder for a coding nothing produces is untested code that only exists to be wrong later. This case pinned br as its token until Anthropic began serving br (PCC-1276); br moved to br-basic and this case kept the rule with the remaining dead coding. If a path starts emitting deflate, this case changes rather than a silent pass-through appearing.
